sections.name: INTRODUCTION
sentences: This is a civil action brought by Plaintiff against Defendant.
The Court has jurisdiction over the subject matter of this action.

sections.name: JURISDICTION AND VENUE
sentences: Jurisdiction and venue are proper in this district pursuant to 28 U.S.C. § 1391(b).
This Court is empowered to hear and determine the claims asserted herein.

sections.name: PARTIES
sentences: Plaintiff is a resident of [State] and brings this action on behalf of herself.
Defendant is a corporation with its principal place of business in [City].

sections.name: FACTUAL ALLEGATIONS
sentences: On or about January 1, 2022, Defendant engaged in conduct that was unlawful under the laws of [State].
As a direct result of Defendant's actions, Plaintiff suffered damages.

sections.name: COUNT I
sentences: Defendant's conduct as alleged in paragraph 5 above constitutes a violation of [Statute].
Plaintiff seeks damages and other relief for Defendant's wrongful conduct.

sections.name: COUNT II
sentences: In addition to the allegations set forth in Count I, Defendant also engaged in further unlawful conduct.
This additional conduct caused Plaintiff further harm and injury.
